description: Worldsemi WS2812B 5050 — addressable RGB LED with integrated controller. 800 kbps single-wire protocol, cascadable, 24-bit color per pixel. The classic maker addressable LED.
name: ws2812b
watch_out_for: 5 V supply (4.5-5.5 V); cascading direction matters (DIN on first LED, DOUT chains to next DIN). Add a 100 nF decoupling cap on each LED's VDD pin. Data line should be impedance-matched to ~50 Ω over long runs; a 100-470 Ω series resistor at the source mitigates ringing.
